purpose: Fifteenth-pass official and first-party verification for five existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator or booking routes, Companies House records and official local-authority planning or licensing records are promoted. Directory-only claims and inferred lease completion are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: An approved advertisement application, active company, live booking route, licence application or digital membership application does not by itself prove open trading, lease completion or Land Registry completion.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 100 Central Road, Worcester Park, London, KT4 8HU
rows.resolved_fact: Acuitus' current property page and its legal brochure independently agree that individuals trading as Kimberley's Nail Design occupy the ground-floor shop under a ten-year full repairing and insuring lease from 28 September 2023 at GBP 25,000 per year, with the two flats held on long leases. Sutton's official planning-search route remains live. These primary records strengthen the lease schedule, but no public first-party operator or official company route was found to independently prove current trading.

Westmorland and Furness application 2025/0969/ADV identifies W.H.Smith as applicant at 44-46 Stricklandgate and records conditional approval on 30 June 2025 for fascia and projecting signs. Companies House records that WH SMITH RETAIL HOLDINGS LIMITED changed its name to TG JONES RETAIL HOLDINGS LIMITED on the same date. This reconciles the auction tenant's continuing legal identity under a new company name and provides exact-site operational evidence after the auction, but it does not establish whether the 26 May 2026 tenant break was exercised or whether the shop remains open today.

Highbrow London's live booking route continues to accept appointments at 3 Station Approach, while a separate current first-party minicab page still uses No.3 Station Approach. Spelthorne's Public Access system is again serving current planning documents, clearing the prior portal-wide technical degradation, but a bounded exact-address search did not yield the beauty-use decision. The A. J. Millan and Highbrow identity remains strongly reconciled; the 3 versus 3A allocation and executed lease remain unresolved.

rows.address: 9-11 Murray Street, Filey, North Yorkshire, YO14 9DF
rows.resolved_fact: North Yorkshire Council still lists Melly Group Limited's Fado & Tide applications at 9 and 11 Murray Street. The pavement representation deadline is 24 July 2026 and the premises-licence deadline is 4 August 2026. At the 23 July 2026 verification point, both are application-stage records rather than grant, lease-assignment or open-trading evidence.

rows.address: 14-18 High Street, Heathfield, East Sussex, TN21 8LS
rows.resolved_fact: Access Gym's current site continues to market memberships for the exact 14-18 High Street premises. Its current mobile application identifies ACCESS GYM LTD and the same exact Heathfield address, providing a second first-party digital operating route. The parish planning record independently identifies Access Gym Ltd as applicant for exact-address fascia and window graphics. This strongly supports the replacement-operator transition, but pre-opening digital infrastructure is not proof that the gym has opened or that an executed occupational agreement exists.
